name: cron_classify_parse_scores
notes: Tolerant classifier-output parser (traced copy mirrors src/cron/classify_items.c::cron_classify_parse_scores which links libjson; twin imports LIVE cron/scripts/classify_items.py::_parse_scores). Covers fences, last-ditch [...] salvage, non-array payloads, out-of-range/negative/float/missing indexes, mixed arrays, whitespace. Value event folds accepted entries canonically (index=score=reason;). Known benign encoding difference not traced: LIVE accepts bool indexes (bool is int in Python) while C rejects them via its integer guard — no bool-index inputs.
